findings.body: The crossing test hard-codes both the signed `actualPaise` in `input` and the fake route footer, so it never obtains the signed value from `DrillTransactionsRepository.summarize` for the same predicate. A break between the issuance summary and route footer would therefore leave this test green. Add the required crossing leaf that summarizes the fixture predicate, converts that exact decimal string to signed paise, issues the context, and opens it through the route.
findings.title: Not done: issuance-summary-to-route footing test

findings.body: The branch registers and exports the signing seam, but no Ask response invokes the summary/signing service or emits `AskResponse.drill`, and no Actual cell calls the route. The story assigns issuance to GL-ANSWER-WIRING and interaction to GL-DRILL-PANEL, so this remains expected deferred work rather than a blocker for this prerequisite task.
findings.title: Later: make the route reachable from Ask answers → GL-ANSWER-WIRING and GL-DRILL-PANEL
